style: Cute modern sticker illustration. Chibi proportions with a big round head, small body, simple friendly face with dot eyes and a tiny smile. Soft rounded shapes, clean warm-brown outline of even thickness, flat pastel colors with one soft shadow tone, no gradients, no texture, very few details so it stays readable at 48 pixels. Each subject sits on a soft pastel circle badge. Same character-design language as the attached orange dragon mascot 'Yongyongi' (ignore the lamp and smoke in the references: the dragon has NO lamp, it has a chubby body, two short legs, small feet and a short tail). Only a tiny Korean touch (a small ribbon or tiny gat hat) where asked, nothing old-fashioned. Plain pure white background outside the badge, generous margin, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no drop shadow.
